The '''Benja-Rihn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Benja-Rihn]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Carthasian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
